timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Being alone right now feels harder than I expected.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps comparing this to being with someone.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like being alone means something is missing.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice how loud the quiet feels.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels the weight of this solitude.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish someone were here with me right now.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels a little embarrassed to be alone.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this loneliness is real.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This feeling is uncomfortable, and that’s okay to say.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can be alone without it meaning something is wrong.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My own company is allowed to be enough.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to fill this quiet to feel okay.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let this stillness be peaceful instead of empty.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can relax into this time alone.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to enjoy my own presence.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be good company for myself.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel whole on my own.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This time alone can be restful, not just lonely.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of enjoying my own company.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that I’m not missing out by being here with myself.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel complete on my own.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can find comfort in this quiet.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels at ease being alone tonight.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning to enjoy time with just myself.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be my own steady presence.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel at peace, alone or not.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to let tonight be enough, just as it is.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
